checks.ask: Is there voltage at the motor terminal box?
checks.expect_ok: rated voltage present at the terminals
checks.how: Check voltage at the motor terminal box; if none, check the starter panel for tripped circuits.
checks.if_bad: Reset tripped circuits at the starter panel, then re-check voltage.

checks.ask: Are the fuses intact and breakers closed?
checks.expect_ok: continuity on all fuses, breakers closed
checks.how: Turn off power, remove fuses, check continuity with an ohmmeter.
checks.if_bad: Replace blown fuses or reset the breaker. If they trip again, the electrical installation, motor, and wires must all be checked.

checks.ask: Is the motor starter overload protection healthy?
checks.expect_ok: voltage on line and load sides, protection not tripped
checks.how: Check voltage on line and load sides of the starter; inspect the starter for other damage.
checks.if_bad: Replace or reset the burned/tripped protection. If it trips again, check supply voltage and the starter holding coil.

checks.ask: Does the starter energize?
checks.expect_ok: holding coil energizes with correct voltage
checks.how: Energize the control circuit and check for voltage at the holding coil.
checks.if_bad: If no voltage, check control-circuit fuses. If voltage is present, check the holding coil for short circuits and replace a bad coil.

checks.ask: Do all safety and pressure switches function correctly?
checks.expect_ok: all control-device contacts clean and switching
checks.how: Check that all safety and pressure switches function; inspect contacts in control devices.
checks.if_bad: Replace worn or defective parts or control devices.

checks.ask: Are the motor windings sound?
checks.expect_ok: balanced lead-to-lead resistance, no ground path
checks.how: Turn off power, disconnect wiring. Measure lead-to-lead resistance (RX-1) and lead-to-ground (RX-100K); record values.
checks.if_bad: If an open or grounded winding is found, remove the motor and repair or replace it.

checks.ask: Is the start capacitor good (single-phase motors)?
checks.expect_ok: needle jumps toward 0 ohms then drifts back to infinity
checks.how: Turn off power, discharge the capacitor, check with an ohmmeter (RX-100K).
checks.if_bad: Replace the defective capacitor.

checks.ask: Does the pump shaft rotate freely by hand?
checks.expect_ok: shaft rotates easily by hand
checks.how: Turn off power and manually rotate the pump shaft.
checks.if_bad: Check the coupling setting and adjust as necessary. If rotation is still tight, remove the pump, disassemble, and repair.
checks.if_ok: All §19 causes exhausted: remove the pump and inspect, or contact Grundfos service.

checks.ask: Is the direction of rotation correct?
checks.expect_ok: counter-clockwise viewed at the coupling
checks.how: Check the wiring against the motor label diagram; bump-start to verify direction.
checks.if_bad: Correct the wiring connections.

checks.ask: Is the pump primed and free of air?
checks.expect_ok: liquid level full at the priming plug
checks.how: Turn pump off, close isolation valves, remove the priming plug, check liquid level.
checks.if_bad: Refill the pump, replace the plug, and restart. Long inlet lines must be filled before starting.

checks.ask: Are strainers, check, and foot valves clear?
checks.expect_ok: no debris in strainer, screen, or valves
checks.how: Remove the strainer, screen, or check valve and inspect.
checks.if_bad: Clean and replace, then reprime the pump.

checks.ask: Is the suction lift within the pump curve?
checks.expect_ok: inlet reading matches performance data
checks.how: Install a compound pressure gauge at the inlet, start the pump, and compare with performance data.
checks.if_bad: Reduce suction lift: lower the pump, increase inlet line size, or remove high-friction-loss devices.

checks.ask: Are inlet pipe, valves, and fittings airtight?
checks.expect_ok: no leaks; pump does not spin backwards at shutdown
checks.how: Inspect inlet pipe, valves, and fittings; watch for backward spin when the pump is turned off.
checks.if_bad: Repair leaks and retighten all loose fittings.

checks.ask: Does the shutoff head match the pump curve?
checks.expect_ok: measured head close to curve shutoff head
checks.how: Install a pressure gauge, start the pump, gradually close the outlet valve, read shutoff pressure, convert psi x 2.31 to feet of head, and compare with the curve.
checks.if_bad: Head well below curve means a worn pump: remove the pump and inspect.

checks.ask: Are impeller and guide-vane passages clear?
checks.expect_ok: no foreign material in passageways
checks.how: Disassemble and inspect the pump passageways.
checks.if_bad: Remove any foreign materials found.

checks.ask: Is the correct drain plug installed?
checks.expect_ok: proper Grundfos drain plug fitted
checks.how: Check the drain plug type: a standard plug in place of the proper plug recirculates water internally.
checks.if_bad: Replace with the proper drain plug.

checks.ask: Is the coupling setting correct?
checks.expect_ok: gaps between coupling halves equal, correct height
checks.how: Check and reset the coupling (service manual coupling-height procedure).
checks.if_bad: Reset the coupling to the specified height and re-check.
checks.if_ok: All §19 causes exhausted: remove the pump and inspect, or contact Grundfos service.

symptom: The pump runs but at reduced performance or does not deliver water.

checks.ask: Is the pressure switch set and functioning?
checks.expect_ok: correct cut-in/out, voltage across closed contacts
checks.how: Check that the pressure switch is set and functions; check voltage across closed contacts.
checks.if_bad: Readjust the switch or replace it if defective.

checks.ask: Is the level control set and functioning?
checks.expect_ok: setting per manufacturer data, correct switching
checks.how: Check that the level control is set and functions correctly.
checks.if_bad: Readjust the setting per the level-control manufacturer's data, or replace if defective.

checks.ask: Is tank air charge sufficient with no leaks?
checks.expect_ok: correct air-to-water volume, no leaks
checks.how: Pump air into the tank or diaphragm chamber; check the diaphragm, tank, and piping with soap-and-water solution; check air-to-water volume.
checks.if_bad: Repair leaks as necessary and restore the air charge.

checks.ask: Is the tank large enough?
checks.expect_ok: about 10 gallons per gpm, air volume 2/3 of total at cut-in
checks.how: Check tank size and air volume against the 10-gal-per-gpm rule.
checks.if_bad: Replace the tank with one of the correct size.

checks.ask: Is the pump correctly sized for the duty?
checks.expect_ok: total head limits delivery within the design flow range
checks.how: Install gauges near inlet and outlet, run under normal conditions, record readings, convert psi x 2.31 to feet, and compare with the pump curve.
checks.if_bad: Throttle the pump outlet flow to hold delivery within the design range.
checks.if_ok: All §19 causes exhausted: contact Grundfos service.

checks.ask: Is the supply voltage stable and wiring sized right?
checks.expect_ok: voltage within -10%/+10%, correct wire sizing
checks.how: Check voltage at the starter panel and motor; check wire sizing.
checks.if_bad: If voltage varies more than -10%/+10%, contact the power company; correct wire sizing.

checks.ask: Is the overload protection set to full-load current?
checks.expect_ok: trip setting at maximum motor nameplate current
checks.how: Cycle the pump and measure amperage against the nameplate full-load current.
checks.if_bad: Increase the overload protection size or adjust the trip setting to maximum nameplate current.

checks.ask: Is the three-phase current balanced?
checks.expect_ok: all leads within -5%/+5%
checks.how: Check current draw on each lead to the motor.
checks.if_bad: Check the motor and wiring; rotating all leads may eliminate the imbalance.

checks.ask: Is the motor free of shorts and grounds?
checks.expect_ok: no open or grounded winding
checks.how: Turn off power, disconnect wiring. Measure lead-to-lead (RX-1) and lead-to-ground (RX-100K or megaohmmeter); record values.
checks.if_bad: If an open or grounded winding is found, remove the motor and repair and/or replace it.

checks.ask: Are wiring and connections sound?
checks.expect_ok: correct wiring, tight terminals, undamaged wires
checks.how: Check proper wiring and loose terminals.
checks.if_bad: Tighten loose terminals; replace damaged wires.

checks.ask: Does the pump shaft rotate freely by hand?
checks.expect_ok: shaft rotates easily by hand
checks.how: Turn off power and manually rotate the pump shaft.
checks.if_bad: Check the coupling setting and adjust as necessary. If rotation is still tight, remove the pump, disassemble, and repair.

checks.ask: Is the start capacitor good (single-phase motors)?
checks.expect_ok: needle jumps toward 0 ohms then drifts back to infinity
checks.how: Turn off power, discharge the capacitor, check with an ohmmeter (RX-100K).
checks.if_bad: Replace the defective capacitor.

checks.ask: Are the protection devices in normal ambient?
checks.expect_ok: ambient at protection devices near motor ambient and below 40 C
checks.how: Use a thermometer to check ambient temperature near the overload protection devices and the motor; record both.
checks.if_bad: If protection devices run hotter than the motor, especially above 104 F (40 C), replace them with ambient-compensated protection devices.
checks.if_ok: All §19 causes exhausted: remove the pump and inspect, or contact Grundfos service.

symptom: Fuses blow or circuit breakers or overload relays trip.
